plays.notes: Source107 ends Ortega’s single and introduces Palomar. At109 pitcher throws to first instead of delivering a pitch; Ortega returns safely.
Center fielder loses fly in lights; source explicitly awards stand-up double, not an error.
Source259 introduces Topanga after De Jesus’s single. Beans Sorensen is ejected during a mound visit although he is not pitching; Hughes remains the active pitcher.
Hard grounder knocked down by Slauson with no play; no error is announced, treated as the narrated base hit.
Intro says Flores’s sixth-inning sac bunt scored a run, but actual sixth-inning sequence advances Vega to second and Stipe’s subsequent double scores him; no RBI assigned to the bunt.
Eddie Kincaid pinch-hits for Virgil Hughes in ninth spot; grounder results in force at second, not a batter putout.
Left-handed Belden Inohosa replaces Hughes for ninth inning; spelling follows transcript.
Final recap reports six Loons hits, but seven are narrated: De Jesus2singles, Vega single, Stipe double, Primero2doubles, and Colbert single. Score2-0 agrees with the ledger.
